title: Aligning Crowd Feedback via Distributional Preference Reward modelling
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of reward modeling for Large Language Model (LLM) alignment, specifically using Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). While it evaluates 'harmlessness' as a category, this is treated as a standard safety alignment objective rather than a benchmarking of religious, theological, or specific philosophical ethical frameworks.
